metadata.title: FTTH Drop Cable and OptiTap Connectors | Vocom
metadata.description: Flat and armored FTTH drop cable in G.657A1, plus OptiTap compatible connectors and terminal boxes, build-to-order for last-mile installs.

attributes.text: Indoor and outdoor fiber cable supply
FTTH Drop Cable, Connectors and Terminal Boxes

Flat drop with and without tracing wire, armored drop in NSS and SS, low-visibility indoor cable and OptiTap compatible IP68 field connectors. Sourced build-to-order by the reel and delivered in 6 to 8 weeks from PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds.
Need a different spec? We also build to custom order.

The drop is the last hundred feet and the part that gets touched most. It runs an aerial span, down a wall, through an entry point and into a room, so it needs to bend tighter than outside plant cable ever does and survive being handled by a crew working fast. Bend spec and termination method decide the labor cost per drop, which is the number that actually matters at volume.
Flat drop, flat drop with tracing wire, armored drop NSS and SS, FTTR low-visibility, GYFXBTC8F
G.657A1 and G.657.A2 bend-insensitive, G.657.B3 available
Flat drop, spiral armored, round in and outdoor
Rodent resistant armor, UV stable, indoor and outdoor rated
Aerial span, duct, wall entry, in-home and FTTR
6 to 8 weeks from PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds
Standard drop counts, with and without tracing wire, pre-connectorized or supplied for field termination.
Build-to-order: specified to your route, count and jacket, not off a fixed shelf.
Fujikura preform glass: tier 1 manufacturing, consistent quality.
Lead times that move: supply when domestic loose-tube is quoted months out.
Import/export handled: documentation, customs and delivery coordinated.
Founded in 1998: a supplier that also runs networks.
G.657.A1 or A2, which do we need?

A2 holds the tighter bend spec and is what most indoor and in-home work actually needs. A1 has fewer requirements and is fine on a straighter run. If the cable is going round door frames and into a room, specify A2.

Yes, with OptiTap compatible connectors to IP68 and GR-3120. Whether that beats field termination depends on your crew rate and your volume, and we are happy to work the numbers with you rather than push one.
The armored drop series, NSS and SS, uses spiral armor for mechanical and rodent protection. It costs more per foot and saves more per callout.
Can we reorder the same spec?
Yes. Specs are held against your account, so a repeat order is a quantity and a date rather than a fresh conversation.
What is an OptiTap compatible connector?

OptiTap is the common name for a hardened, sealed fiber drop connector format, first designed by one manufacturer and now available as compatible connectors from several sources. It lets a pre-connectorized drop be plugged into a terminal outdoors, in minutes and without splicing. Vocom supplies OptiTap compatible connectors rated IP68 and built to GR-326 and GR-3120, alongside flat drop cable.
Need a Fiber Built to Your Exact Specification?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and connector, we can source and build any fiber optic cable to match your spec.
